functions.title: Everything your team needs to be productive
functions.subtitle: Kiki brings essential project-management tools into a clean, fast interface. No distractions, no overload.
functions.detailSubtitle: Every feature designed to reduce friction and increase focus.
functions.kanbanDesc: Organize any project on visual boards with fully customizable lists. Drag and drop tickets between columns, change priorities instantly and keep your team up to date.
functions.collabDesc: Invite your team with a simple link or email. Assign tickets to specific members, manage roles and keep everyone in sync.
functions.notifDesc: Get instant alerts when you are assigned a ticket, when someone comments, or when something important changes. Never lose the thread.
functions.metricsDesc: See each project's progress with bars, weekly activity and per-board metrics. Make decisions from real data.
functions.labelsDesc: Classify tickets with custom color labels and priority levels. Filter and find what you need in seconds.
functions.subtasksDesc: Break complex tickets into manageable steps. Track progress with a visual bar and check items off as you go.
functions.calendarDesc: See every ticket with a due date on a monthly calendar. Plan sprints, deliveries and deadlines clearly.
functions.commentsDesc: Discuss, resolve questions and leave feedback directly on each ticket. Keep the whole project conversation in one place.
functions.linksDesc: Add relevant links to the board: Git branches, deploys, Figma files or any external resource. Stay in context.
functions.linksP1: Quick links in the board header
functions.attachmentsDesc: Upload files directly to tickets: images, documents, screenshots. Project material stays organized and at hand.

privacy.metaDescription: Kikiboard privacy policy and cookie use.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: The controller of data collected through kikiboard.xyz is the team behind Kikiboard. For any privacy question you can contact us at contact@kikiboard.xyz.
privacy.s2AccountBody: name, email address and authentication provider (email/password or Google OAuth), managed through Clerk.
privacy.s2ContentBody: boards, lists, tickets, subtasks, comments and attachments you create on the platform.
privacy.s2UsageBody: activity logs inside boards (actions taken, dates).
privacy.s3P3: Enable collaboration between members of a board.
privacy.s3P4: Send notifications related to user activity.
privacy.s4Intro: Kikiboard uses strictly necessary cookies for the application to work:
privacy.s4SessionBody: managed by Clerk to keep your session active securely.
privacy.s4PrefsBody: stored in localStorage (for example, acceptance of this policy). They are not sent to any server.
privacy.s4NoTrack: We do not use tracking, advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
privacy.s5Vercel: Vercel — deployment infrastructure and file storage.
privacy.s5Footer: Each of these services has its own privacy policy and security measures.
privacy.s6Body: Data is kept while the account is active. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently and irreversibly removed from our database.
privacy.s7Body: You have the right to access, rectify and delete your data. You can exercise these rights from your account settings or by contacting us at contacto@kikiboard.xyz.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy occasionally. For relevant changes we will notify you through the platform or by email.
